fieldNotes.truckGate: The entire site is enclosed by black chain-link fence topped with barbed wire along West Beaver Street and the cross street. A controlled vehicle entrance with yellow bollard-defined lanes leads into the yard/parking.
fieldNotes.guardShack: Street View (pano 30.33214,-81.69696, heading 250) clearly shows a small standalone guard booth set in the middle of the entrance drive, with yellow bollards channelizing traffic around it - a classic staffed checkpoint.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: False - a guard shack is present.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Modest 115,025 sq ft processing plant; dock doors on the south/SW building faces with a few trailers backed in. Estimated ~16, banded 10-25 (low confidence - dense rooftop process equipment partly obscures the dock face).
fieldNotes.dropArea: Trailer drop/parking lot east of the building across the cross street with angled trailer stalls, plus trailers staged in the south yard; estimated 10-25.
fieldNotes.backupSensitive: Urban tight site - the gate/booth entry sits close to West Beaver Street and a signalized intersection with limited stacking depth; a truck queue could spill toward the road.
fieldNotes.drivewayShort: Short approach from the gate to the docks; only 1-2 trucks of stacking room inside.
fieldNotes.railServed: CSX rail tracks run along the south property edge but as a through corridor - no spur enters the building.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: One plant; an adjacent construction/expansion area (office trailers) seen in 2025 imagery relates to the $65M new-line expansion - counted as part of the single facility, buildingCount 2.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Dense urban Jacksonville industrial corridor along West Beaver Street.

citations.claim: Danone North America's own locations page lists this plant at "2198 West Beaver St. Jacksonville, FL 32209". Our roster address for this record is "2198 West Beaver Street, Jacksonville, FL 32209", which matches at street level, and the record's coordinates were geocoded from that address.

divestitureCheck.method: Danone's own locations page is its current operating list, so presence on it is positive evidence the plant is still running. Cross-checked against the 2026 restructuring, which named Bridgeton NJ as the closure and named Mount Crawford, Dallas and Jacksonville as receiving its volume.
divestitureCheck.result: present on the current company locations page; not closed or divested

sources.covers: the 2026 Danone North America manufacturing restructuring and the single US plant closure it produced

verification.claimScope: address-level identity from the operator's own published facility list, plus a geocode of that address. Not an independent parcel survey.
verification.rationale: CONFIRMED: Danone North America publishes this plant on its own locations page with a full street address, and that address matches this record's roster address at street level. The record's coordinates were geocoded from that same address. Identity is therefore address-level from the operator itself; it is not an independent parcel survey. The same page is the operating-status check: it is Danone's current facility list, and the only one of our 13 published Danone sites missing from it is Bridgeton NJ, which Danone closed on 2026-08-02.
